_comment: Marble mode (built on the main game, enemies with number HP): the user's pick per enemy, judged in batches of 5 (2026-11-21). A = the main game's version, B = Die on Stage's. 'appearance' = how they come (groups).

ashling.appearance: B: spirits come two at a time, their attacks alternate

iceling.appearance: B: spirits come two at a time, their attacks alternate

zephling.appearance: B: spirits come two at a time, their attacks alternate

bramble_back.note: Thorns pile up; each of your cards that damages it hurts you that much

winged_tortoise.flying: B flying: while in the air every hit on it deals 1; the 3rd hit knocks it down (stunned 1 turn, +1 Power), then it takes off

leech_bat.flying: B flying: while in the air every hit on it deals 1; the 3rd hit knocks it down (stunned 1 turn, +1 Power), then it takes off
leech_bat.lifesteal: its attacks heal it 100% of the damage they deal

hush_moth.flying: B flying: while in the air every hit on it deals 1; the 3rd hit knocks it down (stunned 1 turn, +1 Power), then it takes off

mirror_fairy.innate: Blinded by the Mirror Fairy: while she is in the fight, your marbles come out showing "?" (you don't know their colour)

greenseer.innate: heals 6 first whenever anyone on his side is hurt

rolling_bear.note: power-up hop when it gains Power

bramble_matron.note: her summoning intent has orb HP Water, Air, Water, Air (WAWA): chant it to cancel the summon; she tries again next turn (as in B)

new_move_kinds: From Die on Stage, new to the main game: Shield on an enemy (block), Dodge on an enemy (foe_dodge: your next hit on it misses), Weaken on you (you deal 50% less). Power = the main game's Empower; heal = Mend in HP.

rules.order: Every enemy's moves go in order (a cycle), never at random (the user, 2026-11-21).
rules.reserve: Cinder Hound and Yeti are kept in reserve for a later act.
rules.intent_orbs: Some intents carry orb HP: a pattern of marbles shown ABOVE the intent. If your chant contains that pattern, the intent is cancelled (2026-11-21).
